title: Heated tube Nusselt number
line: A steady conjugate heat transfer FEA study of laminar water in a uniformly heated copper tube.
description: Laminar water (Re 40) entering at 25 C in a copper tube with an 8 mm bore, 240 mm long, heated with 10 W on its outside. The study returns the wall and centerline temperatures in the developed region, the outlet temperature and the pressure drop; developed flow with uniform flux gives Nu = 4.36, a 38.3 C wall at 180 mm.
thumbnailAlt: Water temperature in a heated copper tube, solved in RunMat
